title: Production Tool: shared definitions
description: Types every other contract uses. Contract version 1 (D1).

sha256.description: Content address of an artifact: the SHA-256 of its bytes. Authoritative; every URL is only a hint.

id.description: Prefixed ULID made by the client: job_…, ref_…, shot_…, frame_…, take_…, rev_…, combine_…, pin_…

tag.description: A user's reference tag, stored once in the strictest form any provider accepts (Runway: 3-16 chars). Adapters rewrite it into each provider's syntax.

refRole.description: What a reference contributes. Adapters map it to provider roles (Runway subject human|object; Kling elements).

region.description: A box in 0-1 coordinates of the image it sits on, origin top-left.

op.description: generate: front view from sketch + refs. combine: 2-4 selected items + one instruction. view: one turnaround view from the chosen front. shot_list: script to shots (director only, no provider). frame: one storyboard frame. region_edit: edit inside a region of a still. clip: frame to video. clip_edit: region comment or feel change on a clip. stitch: shots to one MP4 with the end card.

quotaClass.description: image: generate, combine, view, frame, region_edit. video: clip, clip_edit. render: stitch. text: shot_list.

jobState.description: Same states as app/templates/advertising-studio/app/pipeline.yaml. uncertain: the provider may have accepted the job with no id recorded; reconciled by querying, never by paying again.

cost.description: Three separate numbers, never inferred from each other. confirmed stays absent and unknown true until the provider reports it.

assetRef.description: An artifact passed between browser, relay and provider. url is our CloudFront input path from POST /uploads.

output.description: One result of a job, already copied into our S3 (the provider URL is never handed out).

message.description: One line a participant can read in the node.

providerCode.description: The provider's own code, e.g. SAFETY.INPUT.TEXT or content_policy_violation. For logs.
